RESOLVED: Dear Ms. Whitfield,

Re: Claim CLM-550193 for MRI brain w/o contrast on August 27, 2026

Thank you for reaching out to us about the denial of your MRI claim. We understand that you have questions about the denial reason "prior authorization not on file" and the appeal process.

According to our records, your claim was denied because we did not have a prior authorization on file for the service. However, you may file a first-level appeal within 180 days of the denial notice date. Your ordering provider, Dr. L. Okonjo, may submit a retrospective authorization request with clinical documentation supporting medical necessity.

The deadline for filing an appeal is 180 days from the denial notice date. We will provide you with the exact deadline date, which is [denial notice date + 180 days]. You can obtain the appeal form (FORM-APP-1) by contacting our customer service department.

Please note that standard appeals are decided within 30 calendar days. If you have any further questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to reach out to us.

Sincerely,
ARIA
Meridian Health Plan
